selection_rule: For each selected input group, compare its complete stable online and frozen six-scene canaries. Keep the lower-Q mode per configuration; order the two distinct configurations by six-scene Q before opening DEV24.
dev_gate: Candidate passes only if all 24 DEV runs are complete, finite, stable, and the equal-weight macro Q_0_20_m is strictly below same-scene B. If candidate 1 does not pass, execute candidate 2 once.
